# CDD Affine Group 27 Live Diff

This report compares normal-mode READ BUFFER id=01/02 offset=0x070000 captures after changing LD5M CDD stream 1 affine group 27 from decoded byte 0xe4 to 0xe5, then restoring stock. The drive cold-booted as LD5M after both mutation and restore; CDD1 F0 readback showed chunk-boundary decrypt quirks, so the normal-mode captures are the main behavioral evidence.

The normal READ BUFFER work-window is a rotating tile surface. This
report only compares 0x40-byte chunks that are stable inside each state.
